arcs.title: The New Registry
arcs.summary: Day 2: The Magical Creatures Desk has formally nominated Jersey for the second entry in the 'Wholesome, Not Misc.' registry, citing his July encounter with a Ministry assessor and the mechanism by which he resolves all disputes (getting comfortable, then making others comfortable). Quoyne has received the nomination and cleared the shelf space for a second divider. He has not yet ruled. Day 3 should develop Quoyne's deliberation — perhaps another department files a competing nomination, or Quoyne conducts a quiet inquiry that involves visiting the household or requesting a character reference from an unexpected party (the assessor? the goblins? the ridgeline survey office?). Build warmly toward a Day 4 resolution in which the registry receives its second entry with suitable ceremony.
